text:
Predicates:
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Includes(x, y) ::: x includes y.
Feuds(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Stable(x) ::: x is a professional wrestling stable.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
Premises:
Leads(roderickStrong, diamondMine) ::: Roderick Strong leads Diamond Mine.
Includes(diamondMine, creedBrothers) ∧ Includes(diamondMine, ivyNile) ::: Diamond Mine includes the Creed Brothers, and Ivy Nile.
Stable(diamondMine) ∧ Stable(imperium) ∧ Person(roderickStrong) ∧ Person(ivyNile) ::: Diamond Mine is a professional wrestling stable, formed in WWE. Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.
Conclusion:
¬Feuds(imperium, x) ::: Imperium doesn't have a feud with a professional wrestling stable that includes Ivy Nile.
